'''Andrew Mudd''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Alabama State Championship]] on 29 April 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT/Drain Canceling/Troopers]], according to Rob Ronnlund's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d627">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-i-can-topdeck-anything-al-states-4-29d627/ i-can-topdeck-anything-al-states-4-29], DeckTech (Rob "Darth_Cheese" Ronnlund, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-i-can-topdeck-anything-al-states-4-29d627/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
